gui.the_long_travail.diary.prose.abyss.w:
Where wind and water end,
dawn and dusk hang as one.
Stand here. Speak your heart.
The waves will answer.

The sea is time's expanse,
a dream, a fleeting foam.
Reflected moonlight
rushes to the traveler.
gui.the_long_travail.diary.prose.abyss.m:
O blue as deep as starlit skies,
vast, kind, solemn, fathomless.

The stars align.
The traveler hears
a whisper kin to blood.
Fall, fall, fall…

All things spring from the sea.
Return, then, to the womb.

tooltip.the_long_travail.abyss_items.flu: Place §6Perfect Fluid§r and another item in the crafting grid. Each craft consumes §aone§r §6Perfect Fluid§r to create §aone§r copy.
Duplication preserves the original item's durability, enchantments, custom name, and its own saved data. For containers, it also preserves the items stored inside.

However, §6Perfect Fluid§r cannot be crafted with itself or §6The Long Travail§r. When §6Perfect Fluid§r is crafted with a container, any §6Perfect Fluid§r or §6The Long Travail§r inside §athe container or its nested containers§r is removed from the crafting output. The original contents remain unchanged.
For stackable items, §6Perfect Fluid§r copies only §aone item§r per craft, not the entire stack.
If the target is §aunstackable§r, or the original and copy §acannot stack together§r, crafting consumes §6Perfect Fluid§r and produces §aone copy§r; the original remains in the crafting grid.

Almost any item except §6The Long Travail§r and §6Perfect Fluid§r itself can be copied. Add item IDs to the configuration blacklist to prevent those items from being copied. Blacklisted items inside containers and their nested containers are also removed from the copy, leaving the original contents unchanged.
